## Summary

What does this change, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New component or feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build or CI

## Checklist

- [ ] `gradle :scifikit:assembleRelease` passes
- [ ] Tried on a device or emulator (say which below)
- [ ] The View and Compose versions are both updated, if the change touches rendering
- [ ] The painter does not allocate per frame
- [ ] It respects the system animation setting
- [ ] The README is updated, if the public API changed

## Tested on

Device or emulator, and Android version.

## Screenshots or recordings

Before and after, if the change is visual.
